assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the approved quit-confirmation popup for our 2D game. Extract/redraw ONLY its wooden background board as one production sprite. Keep exactly the reference's warm chestnut wooden inner board, simple caramel-brown wooden frame with dark brown outlines, crisp hand-painted cartoon sprite look, top-left green leaf sprig, bottom-left small cyan crystal cluster and green leaves, bottom-right two small orange mushrooms and green leaves. Same flat front-facing view and horizontal outer-board width-to-height ratio about 1.65:1. REMOVE ALL Korean letters, ALL text, and BOTH green buttons including their borders and shadows. Fill their former areas with uninterrupted plain warm wooden board texture. Nothing inside except wood grain: no title plaque, button recesses, boxes, circles, X, icons, or dividers. Entire board interior must be opaque. Outside the board silhouette must be genuine transparent PNG alpha, not dark gray, not checkerboard artwork. Tight canvas with only a small even transparent margin around the full silhouette, no clipping. Preserve existing corner decoration placement and sizes; don't add new decorations. No gold or metallic trim. No text, lettering, numbers, glyphs, or watermark anywhere. This is a single separate background asset, not a composited finished popup.
